web.title: The 10 Most Spoken Languages In The World In 2026
web.description:
## 3. English — 380 Million Native Speakers
![Map highlighting English-speaking countries: UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand](https://i0.wp.com/cms.babbel.news/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/03_english.jpg?resize=700%2C200&strip=none&ssl=1)

If you’re reading this article, you may be one of the 380 million-odd native English speakers, or one of the billion people who speak it as a second language.

web.title: What Are The Most Popular Languages In The World?
web.description:
## **The Criteria for Popularity** [Anchor](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools/blog/what-are-most-popular-languages-world#the-criteria-for-popularity)
### **Number of Native Speakers**
A native speaker is an individual who speaks a language as their first language, often learned in childhood. [Chinese](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/chinese) leads the pack with nearly 918 million native speakers, followed by [Spanish](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/spanish) and [English](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/english).

## **The Most Popular Languages in the World** [Anchor](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools/blog/what-are-most-popular-languages-world#the-most-popular-languages-in-the-world)
2. [**Spanish**](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/spanish): This language has approximately 460 million native speakers. It is the official or national language in 21 countries, including Spain, Mexico, and most countries in Central and South America.
5. [**Arabic**](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/arabic): With around 310 million native speakers, Arabic has a wide range of dialects and is spoken in numerous countries, particularly in the Middle East and North Africa.
7. [**Portuguese**](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/portuguese): With about 221 million native speakers, Portuguese is the official language of countries like Portugal, Brazil, and Angola.
9. [**Japanese**](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/japanese): With approximately 128 million native speakers, Japanese is predominantly spoken in Japan.

## **The Dominance of English in Business, Science, and more** [Anchor](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools/blog/what-are-most-popular-languages-world#the-dominance-of-english-in-business-science-and-more)
Although it ranks third in terms of native speakers—approximately 379 million—its global reach is unparalleled.

## **Other Noteworthy Languages** [Anchor](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools/blog/what-are-most-popular-languages-world#other-noteworthy-languages)
- [**Arabic**](https://www.middlebury.edu/language-schools//languages/arabic): Spoken by more than 310 million people and critical for understanding the Middle East.
- **Hindi**: Key for anyone interested in South Asia, with over 310 million native speakers.
